Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin

 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_min_temp number(5,2);
 temp_count number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select b.min_temp, b.max_temp
 into temp_min_temp, :max_temp
 from batch_inputs b
 where b.batch_id = :batch_id and
 substr(b.batch_id,8,2) = 'CB' and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 exists (select 'x'
 from units
 where batch_id = b.batch_id
 and nvl(qc_checkin_flag,'*') != 'Y'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into :s_unit_count
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 nvl(qc_checkin_flag,'*') != 'Y';
 if :s_unit_count = 0
 then
 show_error('0085');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :qc_checkin_flag not in ('Y','N','')
 then
 show_error('1203');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if :units.coll_date is null and
 :qc_checkin_flag in ('Y','N')
 then
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 /*-- Donor decision code is required if chapter level parameter CUE_SCAN_FLAG
 is set to 'Y'. The value of the chapter level parameter is stored
 in the corresponding global variable. ----*/

 :drive_id is null or
 :red_tube_flag is null or
 :purple_tube_flag is null or
 :serum_plasma_ind is null or
 :red_tube2 is null) and
 :qc_checkin_flag = 'Y'
 then

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_all_units_ok VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 temp_all_units_ok := 'Y';
 go_block('units');
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :qc_checkin_flag in ('N','')
 then
 temp_all_units_ok := 'N';
 exit;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if temp_all_units_ok = 'Y'
 then
 :perform_commit := 'Y';
 execute_trigger('do_commit');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 end if;
end;

 then
 :qc_checkin_flag := '';
 else
 if (:global.cue_scan_flag = 'Y' and :donor_decision_code is null) or
 :drive_id is null or
 :red_tube_flag is null or
 :purple_tube_flag is null or
 :serum_plasma_ind is null or
 :red_tube2 is null
 then

 else

 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_attrib_group_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'ATTR' and
 code = :attrib_group and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select attrib_desc
 into :s_attrib_code_desc
 from valid_attributes
 where attrib_group = :attrib_group and
 attrib_code = :attrib_code and
 unit_scheme_type = decode(NVL(length(:unit_attributes.unit_id), 0),13,'I','C') and 
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: DO_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :perform_commit = 'Y'
 then
 go_block('units');
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :qc_checkin_flag in ('Y','N')
 then
 :qc_checkin_date := sysdate;
 if :units.coll_date is null or
 (:global.cue_scan_flag = 'Y' and :donor_decision_code is null) or
 :drive_id is null or
 :red_tube_flag is null or
 :purple_tube_flag is null or
 :serum_plasma_ind is null or
 :red_tube2 is null
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :units.unit_id, :units.coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'DATA',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions DATA not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;

 else
 if :qc_checkin_flag is not null
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :units.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :units.coll_date;
 show_error('0225');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if not form_failure
 then
 update batch_inputs
 set qc_date = sysdate
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 qc_date is null;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 if form_success
 then
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
end;
